title: Resolve
selection_exposition: Late in the journey, after Hammer's death, Rico and Fei face a grief neither can simplify.<New>By then the world has already transformed, and Rico must decide what returning to Nortune would mean.<Close>
blocks:
CHAPTER 7
RESOLVE<New>After Hammer's death.<Close>

[Hammer's final betrayal leaves no
victor. Fei has lost a friend. Rico
has lost the man who once made D Block
feel less empty.]<Close>

<Fei>
Hammer always wanted to be noticed.<New>By the time we understood how afraid
he was, he could no longer hear us.<Close>

<Rico>
He sold us out. He tried to kill us.<New>And he was still Hammer.<Close>

<Fei>
I know.<Close>

<Rico>
Do you?<New>In D Block, he could talk his way
through any locked gate.<New>But he never believed there was a
place for him after it opened.<Close>

<Fei>
Rico...<Close>

<Rico>
I'm not excusing him.<New>I'm saying I saw it and let him turn
it into a joke because that was
easier for both of us.<Close>

LATER
The worldwide mutation has broken
ordinary contact. One weak Kislev
carrier reaches the Yggdrasil.<Close>

KISLEV DISPATCH
COLLAR NETWORK: DISMANTLED
BATTLING ARENA: CLOSED<New>COMMITTEE PRISONERS: HELD
ARCHIVE COPIES: DELIVERED
FINAL TRANSMISSION INTERRUPTED<Close>

<Rico>
So they got that much done.<Close>

Rico lays a clean sheet on the desk
and begins a letter, not knowing when
Nortune will be able to answer.<Close>

<Rico>
To D Block--this is Rico.<New>Keep this letter where everyone behind
those gates can read it.<Close>

<Rico>
Hammer is dead.<New>He made choices I can't defend, and
paid for them before any of us could
find another way.<Close>

<Rico>
Don't turn him into a hero. Don't
turn him into a monster either.<New>Remember the man who could get food
for a whole floor, then steal half of
it back in a card game.<Close>

<Rico>
Remember that a cage can stay inside
somebody after the gate opens.<New>If Nortune means to change, it has to
make room for people who don't yet
know how to live outside one.<Close>

<Rico>
Sigmund, if you hear this, I have not
forgiven you.<New>Do not mistake my return for that.<Close>

<Rico>
I am coming back because promises
were made to people who spent their
lives waiting.<New>Somebody has to see whether those
promises became more than words.<Close>

<Rico>
I won't come back as an heir. I won't
come back as the Champ.<New>Those are names other people used to
decide where I belonged.<Close>

<Rico>
I will come back as myself.<New>That will have to be enough.<Close>

RICO'S LETTER
FOR D BLOCK
RETURN: NORTUNE<Close>

Rico folds the letter. The grief
remains. It no longer decides the
direction of his next step.<Close>

<Rico>
Mother... I remember the door.<New>There are still people waiting
outside it.<Close>
On the folded letter, Rico draws a stonebell growing between two stones and a few drops of water falling toward its roots.<New>He opens the door and begins the journey back to Nortune.<Close>
THE END<Close>
